ios.desc:
Life moves fast. Time Atlas helps you remember everything, for FREE (advanced features available with a paid subscription).

Time Atlas is an automatic visual diary, which captures your daily life: places you visit, paths you take, activities you participate in and photos you take along the way. The app gives you a snapshot of each day as it really was – in full context. Your story is elegantly curated for you, with no effort whatsoever. Shape it further as you wish!

It runs quietly in the background, turning your routine into a clear picture of your day. No manual inputs required, no wearable device needed. You get a private, personal record of your days – so you can revisit any day, recall any moment and rediscover your past. Photos you take during the day appear automatically in your story – curate them freely with elegant results.

WHAT TIME ATLAS LETS YOU DO

* Automatically capture your location and activity day by day.
* View a snapshot of any day in your past – all in full context.
* Explore where you went, how you got there and what happened along the way.
* Build and curate your daily story, narrated with photos, maps, activity spotlights, place visits and more.
* Effortlessly keep track of your travels, vacations and work trips.
* Choose what content you want to see of any day and customize how it all is laid out.
* Recall any moment in the past easily and at a glance.
* Add context when you want to, for example by writing notes.
* Keep everything private and encrypted on your device.
* Connect to your Apple Health for deeper insights.
* Turn on Eco Mode for lower battery use.
* Import your diary from Apple Journal app or Day One, or your location history from Google Timeline.
* Unlock Time Atlas Plus for advanced features.

WHY IT MATTERS

* You don't miss out on the important moments and memories in your life.
* Recalling that significant day, moment, life event or vacation trip becomes an absolute delight.
* A valuable record of your days is stored for the future, archived automatically.

AUTOMATIC

* Turn "Always" on in your location permissions, so the app can accurately analyze your movements.
* Turn "Full" on in your photo permissions, so the app is able to populate your days with appropriate photos.

PRIVACY COMES FIRST

show_hn.title: Show HN: iOS App Time Atlas, Private, Automatic Activity Tracker. Feedback Plz

quotes.text:
Hey everyone,

We just launched an app called Time Atlas. It’s a lightweight journaling-style tool that helps you:
– Track where your time actually goes
– Reflect on how different activities affect your energy and mood
– Spot patterns over time to help prioritize what really matters

The idea came from frustration, I’d finish a week feeling exhausted, but I couldn’t pinpoint why. With Time Atlas, you can quickly log what you did and how it felt, without having to keep long diary entries.

I’d love your thoughts on:
– What features would make this more useful to you?
– Do you prefer minimal design vs. richer data/analytics?
– How do you currently track (if at all) your time or journaling habits?

We are early in the process, so any feedback is super appreciated, bugs, UX, feature ideas, or just general impressions. Thanks!
